answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral in an escrow, while attestations bind keys and timing. If k coordinated identities equivocate on conflicting histories, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), charging pairwise conflicts against their escrows; detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, with asymmetric depreciation making a sybil swarm economically prohibitive. Saffron, signal, and timber identifiers cannot hide common control when evidence links their behavior.
